events.description: Anthropic began trading on the Nasdaq Thursday after pricing its IPO at $83 per share, valuing the artificial intelligence giant at $1.5 trillion and surpassing SpaceX as the largest initial public offering on record. The IPO puts to the test Wall Street's faith in ​the AI boom, pitting promises of the technology as an economic game-changer against fears of a market bubble and risks to humanity.

The move has caught the other candidates on the left and in the centre off guard, notably Raphaël Glucksmann. FRANCE 24's Clovis Casali explains.

events.title: Myanmar's Rohingya case: how does the ICJ define genocide?
events.description: The ICJ is preparing to rule on whether Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, in a case brought by The Gambia after the 2017 crackdown. The key legal test is proving intent to destroy a group, which is notoriously hard, and the court’s reading of it could also weigh on South Africa’s case against Israel.
